name: exec_review_checkpoint
description: Records a reviewer decision on an executed checkpoint. Triggers human interlock if decision is wait_human.

seq.description: Sequence number of the checkpoint result event being reviewed.

next_instructions.description: Instructions or command modifications for the executor next turn.

notes.description: Review findings or rationale for decision.

proposed_action.description: What action requires human approval if decision is 'wait_human'.
